mapper.select: SELECT * FROM promotion_link WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_key = #{requestKey}
SELECT * FROM promotion_link WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_key = #{requestKey} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion_link WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT l.*, p.provider_name, d.title AS drama_title, m.media_type, m.account_name AS media_account_name FROM promotion_link l JOIN short_drama_provider p ON p.id = l.provider_id JOIN provider_drama d ON d.id = l.drama_id JOIN promotion_media_account m ON m.id = l.media_account_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion_link (user_id, provider_id, connection_id, drama_id, media_account_id, request_key, tracking_no, campaign_name, provider_code, landing_type, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{providerId}, #{connectionId}, #{dramaId}, #{mediaAccountId}, #{requestKey}, #{trackingNo}, #{campaignName}, #{providerCode}, #{landingType}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE promotion_link SET status = 'FAILED', last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE promotion_link SET status = #{status}, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
